WPSS No. 2113 of 2022
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Yogesh C. Tiwari, Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties.
Issue notice to respondent no.3, 
returnable at an early date, by registered 
post, acknowledgment due.
List this matter on 01.03.2023.
Considering the submission 
advanced by learned counsel for the 
parties, it is directed that, subject to 
petitioner depositing 60% of back wages 
before learned Labour Court within six 
weeks from today, execution of 
impugned award dated 25.04.2022, shall 
remain stayed. 
Stay application (I.A. No. 1 of 
2022) stands disposed of.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 10.11.2022
Arpan
